title: Notion API returns object_not_found for a page or database that exists and opens fine in the app
symptoms: Could not find database with ID: 249d19fb-3530-80fc-a7ba-edbe8fde08f4. Make sure the relevant pages and databases are shared with your integration.
Search with no query returns an empty results array in a workspace full of pages
cause: An integration token can read nothing until a person connects that integration to a page or database in the Notion UI. The API answers with the same 404 it uses for an ID that does not exist.
fix: Connect the integration on the top-level page that holds everything it needs, then retry. Treat a 404 on a known ID as a sharing problem first.
apply: Notion page > ••• menu (top right) > scroll down to Add connections > search the connection name > select it from the dropdown list
affected: Notion REST API, internal and public integrations, all API versions, as of 2026-10
